algorithm: flow-based VLA (GR00T N1-style): VLM backbone + DiT action expert trained with a flow-matching objective, in a three-stage recipe (large-scale human-video pretraining, aligned human-robot mid-training, task-specific post-training)
hand: Sharpa Wave (22-DoF); cross-embodiment target Unitree G1 (7-DoF tri-finger hand)
success_criterion: rubric — Real-robot task completion score (fine-grained, continuous partial credit) plus a binary real-robot task success rate (Sec. 3.1); the binary predicate itself is not defined in the note.
headline_metric: real-robot average task completion score vs. no-pretraining baseline
headline_value: human pretraining improves average task completion by over 55% vs. training from scratch (Fig. 4); log-linear scaling law between validation loss and human-data hours (R²=0.9983), average completion rises from 0.30 at 1k hours to 0.71 at 20k hours (Fig. 5); one-shot transfer: 0.88 success on Fold Shirt, 0.55 on Unscrewing Water Bottles (Fig. 6); G1 cross-embodiment: >30 percentage-point absolute improvement (Fig. 7)
human_data: own in-the-wild egocentric video (20,854 hours total: bulk from 9,869 scenes/6,015 tasks/43,237 objects with off-the-shelf SLAM+hand-pose estimation, plus 829 hours of the existing EgoDex dataset); Stage II aligned mid-training adds ~50 hours human + ~4 hours robot data across 344 tabletop tasks
note_gaps: no explicit Limitations section was found in the parsed text; the Conclusion section was not read in full for additional caveats
operator_interface: large-scale pretraining: in-the-wild egocentric video with off-the-shelf SLAM + hand-pose estimation, no dedicated capture rig; aligned mid-training: Vive trackers for 3D wrist pose + Manus gloves for 25-joint in-hand pose, same camera rig as the robot
retargeting_objective: human 21-keypoint (MANO-style) hand pose retargeted via an optimization-based procedure enforcing joint limits and kinematic constraints into the 22-DoF Sharpa Wave hand joint space; wrist motion is represented as a shared relative SE(3) transform identical across human and robot data
